description: Check the person's own draft ? a memo, a chapter, notes (text, markdown, Word, PDF) ? as a starting point. One voice: its definite statements come back as claims to check, its questions join the open questions, and the citations it carries (urls, DOIs, arXiv ids) are fetched onto the shelves; one that cannot be read becomes a source request. Nothing becomes a finding. verify=true files one research run that checks the claims against sources, the draft's own citations included. Paths from the keeper only.

collection.description: Where the draft and its citations are shelved (default drafts).

fetch_citations.description: Fetch the citations onto the shelves (default true).

path.description: The draft on this machine (absolute path).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

title.description: A title (default: the document's own, or the file name).

verify.description: File one research run that checks the claims.

name: library_check
